Record Class ConfiguredSubscriber<T>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.jwcarman.substrate.core.subscription.ConfiguredSubscriber<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of values delivered to this subscriber
Record Components:
onNextHandler - invoked with each delivered value
onCompletedHandler - invoked when the source is completed
onExpiredHandler - invoked when the source expires
onDeletedHandler - invoked when the source is deleted
onCancelledHandler - invoked when the subscription is cancelled
onErrorHandler - invoked with any error raised while delivering
All Implemented Interfaces:
Subscriber<T>
public record ConfiguredSubscriber<T>(Consumer<T> onNextHandler, Runnable onCompletedHandler, Runnable onExpiredHandler, Runnable onDeletedHandler, Runnable onCancelledHandler, Consumer<Throwable> onErrorHandler) extends Record implements Subscriber<T>
Immutable Subscriber implementation backed by individually registered handler fields. Unset (null) handlers are silently ignored.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:

      Parameters:

      Returns:
